hard_gaps.reason: g4_npc_materialization_rules and region_npc_profile_sets belong to v2 world_revisions/graph_nodes; these Spatial v3 G4 refs must not be inserted into those FK fields. Connect through the existing approved-procedural-NPC owner with a reviewed Spatial v3 binding.
Exact target actor appearance/base-attribute catalog, profile digests, seed, G5 anchor and position must come from approved target/committed generated scene bindings.

Existing equipment authoring covers fisher and boatman only, adult male basic garments; target activation, footwear, women and remaining occupations lack exact bindings. Every selected NPC requires clothing/equipment appropriate to actual sex, role, occupation and season, with property basis.
Regional schedule prose is not an executable activity. Select exact approved activity/body refs and real equipment before initial current_activity. Do not invent health, energy or satiety values.

ordinary_day_work_routine_v1 is approved in the scenario source. Reuse outside that binding is an analogical authoring proposal requiring independent approval; exact seasonal activity and current-time start still required.

Primary treaty and chronicle sources support bounded regional-origin authoring, not exact individual language competence. language_status remains unknown and language_repertoire null. A language-specific action requires separately approved language_ref, proficiency_ref and source_refs; never infer from origin or appearance.

Before nonzero materialization, exact generated scene position, land/water support and activity/equipment must admit each NPC. A boatman/merchant on water needs a committed vessel and occupancy binding; occupation labels alone never create vessels, cargo, households or land.

regional_context_sources.title: A Treaty of Novgorod with Gotland and the German Cities
regional_context_sources.edition: George Vernadsky, ed., A Source Book for Russian History, vol. 1, Yale University Press, 1972, pp. 69-70
regional_context_sources.direct_claim: The treaty names merchants from Novgorod, Gotland and German lands and reciprocal travel.
exclusions: No Lower Dvina presence or frequency
Legal clauses not imported into gameplay

regional_context_sources.title: Novgorod First Chronicle, younger recension, entry 6736 [1228]
regional_context_sources.edition: Novgorodskaia pervaia letopis starshego i mladshego izvodov, published text with variants, p. 271
regional_context_sources.direct_claim: The entry names Izhorians and Karelians in the Ladoga/Neva conflict.
exclusions: Does not attest ordinary trade by these participants
Does not attest Lower Dvina residents or travelers
No language repertoire, ethnicity frequency or individual biography

origin.historical_basis: Gotland merchants are directly attested for Novgorod; presence in target generated G5 is analogical reconstruction.
